title: In Korea, the Subway Is Free After 65

slides.headline: In Korea, the subway is free **after 65.**
slides.note: No ride limit. No time limit.

slides.headline: It started in **1984**
slides.body: The government made subway rides free for everyone 65 and over. Back then, fewer than 1 in 20 Koreans was that old. Now it is 1 in 5.

slides.headline: A **senior card** opens the gate
slides.body: Turn 65, show your ID, and you get a free-ride transit card. You tap in like everyone else.

slides.headline: Day trips **to the hot springs**
slides.body: Line 1 runs about two hours south to the Onyang hot springs. Some seniors ride out for a soak and lunch, then ride home free.

slides.headline: Some ride **to work**
slides.body: Senior couriers carry parcels across Seoul by subway. The free ride is what makes the job pay.

slides.headline: Someone **pays the fare**
slides.body: The subway operators do. Seoul Metro lost ₩448.8 billion (about $310 million) on free rides in 2025.

slides.headline: Free senior rides on Seoul's subway **in 2025**
Should it be **70?**
slides.body: Daegu is raising its free age one year at a time, to 70 by 2028. Seoul is debating the same. Others want rush hour left out.

slides.headline: A thank-you **or a bill?**
slides.body: Seniors see it as a thank-you for building the country. Younger riders see the losses. Both ride the same train.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.

caption:
In Korea, turn 65 and the subway stops charging you.

Seoul's subway lost ₩448.8 billion on it last year, and the country is arguing over raising the age to 70.

At what age should a free ride start?
reply: One catch: the free pass is for subways. Seoul's city buses still charge seniors. Would you give up the free ride at 65 to keep it running?
fact_check: 1장: 노인복지법 제26조·시행령 — 65세 이상 도시철도 무임. 횟수·시간 제한 없음.
3장: 신분증으로 우대용(어르신) 교통카드 발급, 개찰구에서 태그.
4장: 1호선 신창행이 온양온천역 경유, 서울에서 약 2시간. 노인 온천 나들이 다수 보도.
5장: 지하철 택배(실버택배) — 노인 배송원이 무임승차로 배송.
8장: 대구 2024년부터 매년 1세 상향, 2028년 70세(헤럴드경제 2026-06-29). 서울시 70세 상향 검토·7월 공청회. 2026-03-24 국무회의 출퇴근 시간 제한 검토 지시.
댓글: 서울 시내버스는 노인 무임 없음(70세 이상 무료는 공약·검토 단계).
9장: 무임승차 찬반 여론(헤럴드경제 2026-06-29 인터뷰) 요약, 수치 없음.
